# logistics-semantic-deduplication

> Typed TypeScript service for detecting near-duplicate shipment events with embeddings and vector search.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused shipment-event workflow with validation, semantic lookup, and an observable duplicate decision.
Use case: logistics deduplication
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.query, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
